shots.visual: Early morning in the village square. A big brass thali on a decorated table is completely empty except for a few golden crumbs. Bhola stands in front of it with both paws on his head, in total shock.
shots.camera: quick push-in on Bhola's shocked face

lines.speaker: bhola
lines.hi: हाय राम! त्योहार के सारे लड्डू गायब हो गए!

shots.visual: Kallu the crow sits on a branch above, eating a peanut, looking at Bhola whose mouth is sticky with sugar syrup. Bhola quickly tries to wipe his mouth with his scarf.

lines.speaker: kallu
lines.hi: मैंने तो कुछ नहीं देखा... बस भोला के मुँह पर चाशनी लगी है!

shots.visual: Chikki the detective fox strides into the square, flips her trench jacket collar up, and snaps her magnifying glass up in front of her eye with a confident smirk. Kallu rolls his eyes.
shots.camera: low angle hero shot of Chikki, then cut to Kallu

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: चिंता मत करो! मैं हूँ इंस्पेक्टर चिक्की!

lines.speaker: kallu
lines.hi: पिछली बार तूने खुद को ही पकड़ लिया था!

shots.visual: Close-up on the ground: Chikki crouches with her magnifying glass and finds a tiny star-shaped mark pressed into the dust next to a laddoo crumb. Bhola and Kallu lean in behind her, worried.
shots.camera: top-down close-up of the mark, then slow pull back to the three of them

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: ये पंजे नहीं... ये निन्जा स्टार है!

shots.visual: Cliffhanger. On a hut rooftop in the misty background, Saaya, a dark silhouette with glowing yellow eyes, bites into a laddoo. The three heroes below do not notice. Saaya slowly raises a shuriken toward Chikki.
shots.camera: slow zoom from the heroes up to the rooftop figure
